name: browser-p2-shims
description: Interactive browser demo for WASI Preview 2 shims

scripts.build:component: jco componentize src/component.js --wit wit --world-name component --out component.wasm --disable random
scripts.transpile: jco transpile component.wasm --instantiation async --async-mode jspi --async-wasi-imports --async-wasi-exports --async-exports 'example:browser-p2-shims/cli-demo#write-to-stdout' 'example:browser-p2-shims/cli-demo#write-to-stderr' 'example:browser-p2-shims/outgoing-http-demo#request' -o demo/transpiled
scripts.build: pnpm run build:component && pnpm run transpile
scripts.all: pnpm run build && pnpm run test
